browser_transport: Secure HttpOnly host-only Account session/refresh cookies; SameSite protection plus server-validated Origin and session-bound CSRF proof for mutations. Cookie names/path and concrete middleware integration require auth transport compatibility proof. Native approved bearer flow uses same ACCOUNT_V1/session checks; never raw token in SSR HTML, logs or localStorage. No auth-grade transition based on client persona.
scalars: UUID canonical; positive BIGINT revisions/epochs as decimal strings; UTC RFC3339 instants; immutable owner refs schema-validated. User-controlled role/title/person identity/generation does not enter trusted context.
errors: 403 known action denied where discovery permits distinction
428 enrolled legacy route requires Account-aware witness/protocol
422 typed schema/condition or publication prerequisite invalid
503 authority_unavailable/projection_plan_invalid; fail closed without hidden diagnostic payload
compatibility: New tokens cannot enter legacy parsers. Migrated legacy aliases delegate same owner or reject. Enrolled object/data scope closes old list/detail/history/export/action access too. Employer OTP/reset disabled for migrated Accounts before creation; existing employer bootstrap revoked. No new auth API claims applicant/business functionality already implemented. For every migrated subject with account_security, all legacy access/refresh are permanently refused on every successful authentication path, including non-enrolled data and after recovery. Fresh primary authentication required; no legacy-family/generation invention.
